readme.excerpt: Open WebUI Open WebUI is a home for AI : an extensible, easy-to-use, self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline. Connect local models through Ollama or use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models. English 简体中文 繁體中文 한국어 Deutsch Español Français Italiano Dansk 日本語 Polski Русский Bosanski العربية Norsk Português (Brasil) ไทย Türkçe Українська বাংলা Ελληνικά Tiếng Việt Explore Open WebUI → Installation Python Then open http://localhost:8080. Docker Then open http://localhost:3000. Image tag Includes --------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- `:main` Standard image with local AI dependencies `:slim` Lightweight image using external services for embeddings, document extraction, and voice `:cuda` Open WebUI with CUDA acceleration `:ollama` Open WebUI bundled with Ollama `:dev` Latest development build Add these options to `docker run` before the image name as needed: Option Purpose ---------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- `-e OLLAMA BASE URL=http://your-ollama-server:11434` Connect to Ollama on another server `-e OPENAI API KEY=your secret key` Set your OpenAI API key `-e HF HUB OFFLINE=1` Disable Hugging Face model downloads for offline use `--gpus all` Enable Nvidia GPU access for `:cuda` or `:ollama`; requires
